company.name: VUZ
company.shortDescription: VUZ is the leading and fastest growing immersive company and #1 immersive platform in entertainment, sports, and live immersive experiences.
company.description:
VUZ is the leading immersive video app that allows users to stream on the web, mobile, TV, and headsets XR digital experiences with a new level of immersive realism. VUZ owns exclusively the world's largest premium exclusive immersive content library, with over 30,000 hours of immersive content covering entertainment, creators, and sports segments, as well as XR, VR, and AR experiences from virtually anywhere in the world. VUZ has exclusive immersive rights for LaLiga, PFL, SerieA and many others. It aims to bring people together and connect the world by providing authentic immersive experiences while removing (TTA) Travel, Time, and Access constraints for billions of people worldwide.

VUZ was established on January 1, 2017, with offices in Los Angeles, Dubai, and Riyadh.
